reserves.name: Tokenized treasury collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund

reserves.name: Cash
reserves.issuerOrObligor: M0 permissioned issuers' eligible custody arrangements

reserveReview.rationale: MoonPay identifies XO as built on M0 infrastructure, and the configured first-party M0 producer reports the captured reserve mix as 97.9% eligible tokenized Treasury collateral and 2.1% cash after normalization. M0's token time series identifies USTB as the eligible collateral; MoonPay's terms retain the XO-specific segregation and legal context.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live M0 collateral capture for XO, MoonPay XO announcement, and stablecoin terms
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: M0 reports a 0.000115% non-eligible token-collateral residual below the displayed two-slice precision and does not identify its obligor; XO-specific provider shares remain undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The first-party current endpoint reports this residual but does not identify the token or obligor.

providers.name: Regulated financial institutions, qualified custodians, and secure wallets (not publicly named)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: MoonPay requires reserve assets to be segregated from corporate funds and held for stablecoin holders. The terms do not identify XO's providers or shares, establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, or state a rehypothecation prohibition.
